meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 审查最近的代码改动（或你指定的文件），先补回归测试锁定行为，再分类移除冗余注释、过度防御代码、死代码等 AI 生成的“代码气味”，最后用质量门验证。产出为清理后的代码与报告。
howto.when: 当用户要求清理、去除“AI 味”或移除最近更改中的 AI 生成代码模式时触发。

say.text: 清理我最近分支改动里的 AI 生成代码，保持行为不变。
say.note: 先写回归测试再清理，保证功能不被破坏。

say.text: 把这两个文件里的死代码和多余防御删掉，先补上对应测试。
say.note: 将按规则分类处理并运行检查。

say.text: 看看这次改动里有没有不必要的抽象，有就简化，先锁定行为。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews recent changes (or given files), locks behavior with regression tests, then removes AI-generated smells (redundant comments, dead code, etc.) and verifies via quality gates. Outputs cleaned code and a report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

say_en.text: Clean up AI-generated code in my recent branch changes, keeping behavior intact.
say_en.note: It adds regression tests before cleaning.

say_en.text: Remove dead code and over-defensive checks in these files; add tests first.
say_en.note: It will classify and clean, then run checks.

say_en.text: Check this diff for needless abstractions; simplify them after locking behavior.
